scope: Ten Newton trials; no completed Cup, boat or Star. A projected band overpass does not certify whole-loop threading.

stops.scope: First rejected 30 Hz sample, not a substep contact event. Failed state is retained for diagnosis.

accepted_prefix_motion.scope: Accepted prefix; failed terminal frames excluded.

material_support_tracking.scope:
Follow original material supports through clamping and little-loop release.

This is a material-continuity diagnostic, not a threading certificate. Extra
contact patches remain in the report. Particle samples and enabled knuckle
meshes are checked; rope-edge contact alone cannot establish a material track.
The optional six-support audit also follows the original little loops before
their intended release and writes a separate report.

dynamic_near_grip_audit.scope:
Check near-strand proximity and accidental old-loop pairing during motion.

This checks each recorded frame, without requiring a stationary hold. Contact
fractions and edges may change. It is not a force, topology, collision or
original-support certificate; run those separate diagnostics as well.

loop_release_audit.scope: Necessary release diagnostics only; not a threading or figure certificate. Excludes swept collisions, full robot self-collision checks, rope-radius clearance at robot-body meshes and material identity. Central-body boxes and complete-edge arm/body hull checks are conservative: overlap does not by itself prove penetration of the original mesh.

interval_little_own_palm.scope: PIP/DIP capsules against their own convex palm; adjoining MCP excluded. Sampled poses, not full robot self-collision certification.

loop_release_audit.initialization: Independent placement, not replay of Position 1 or source dynamics

near_pinch_edge_audit.scope:

certificate. Run the physical release audit and original-support tracker too.
Edge mode permits the contacted fraction to move within one persistent material
edge; it does not establish persistence of a particular point on that edge.
